<header class="interior-hero">
<p class="eyebrow">Open materials</p>
<h1>Reproduce the publication</h1>
<p class="deck">The published results begin with six frozen CSVs. No model API key or fresh PolicyEngine dataset is required.</p>
</header>

<section class="reproduce-section">
<div class="section-index"><span>01</span><p>Build</p></div>
<div class="section-body">
<p>Install <a href="https://docs.astral.sh/uv/">uv</a>, Quarto 1.9.38, and a LaTeX distribution, then run:</p>

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MaxGhenis/llm-eti.git
cd llm-eti
uv sync --python 3.13 --group dev --frozen
make publication
```

<p>The target regenerates every table, figure, and headline value; runs the offline test and static-analysis suites; renders the site and web paper; compiles the PDF; retains the TeX source; and checks for generated-file drift.</p>
</div>
</section>

<section class="reproduce-section">
<div class="section-index"><span>02</span><p>Boundary</p></div>
<div class="section-body">
<p>The exact historical PolicyEngine-US and upstream dataset revisions were not recorded by the legacy generator. The checked-in `data/scenarios.csv` is therefore the scenario boundary. The five archived response files under `data/responses/` are the model-output boundary.</p>
<p><a class="inline-link" href="https://github.com/MaxGhenis/llm-eti/blob/main/data/run_manifest.json">Inspect the run manifest and SHA-256 digests ↗</a></p>
</div>
</section>

<section class="reproduce-section">
<div class="section-index"><span>03</span><p>Outputs</p></div>
<div class="section-body output-list">
<p><code>paper/generated/analysis_summary.json</code><span>Machine-readable sample counts, slopes, confidence intervals, sensitivities, and input hashes.</span></p>
<p><code>paper/figures/</code><span>Publication figures in PNG, SVG, and PDF.</span></p>
<p><code>_site/paper/llm-eti.pdf</code><span>Compiled paper.</span></p>
<p><code>_site/paper/llm-eti.tex</code><span>Retained LaTeX generated from the same Quarto source.</span></p>
<p><code>_site/paper/llm-eti-source.zip</code><span>Directly compilable TeX source with bibliography and figures.</span></p>
</div>
</section>
